findings.title: Regex literals can fabricate verified empty inventories
findings.change: js_var_assignment_tails is a lexically sound mini lexer returning Result: regex literals are tokenized by previous-token context (regex after start/operator/( , [ { ; :/expression keyword/if-while-for-with head; division after identifier/number/literal/)/]); `/` after `}` or after ++/--, template substitutions `${`, unterminated strings/comments/regexes and unbalanced brackets are rejected as unsupported lexical contexts (ParseFailed, never EmptyPage); `var result` counts only at brace depth 0; Annex B `-->` line comments are comments; js_statement_ends requires the statement to end where the JSON ends (`;`, end, or a line break followed by a non-continuing word). The reviewer's `/;var result = {…}/` decoy yields `inventory variable absent`.

findings.title: Encoded password fields without a semicolon bypass login detection
findings.change: decode_entity decodes numeric character references with or without the trailing `;` (maximal digit run, 0/surrogates/out-of-range → U+FFFD), and legacy named references amp/lt/gt/quot without `;` unless `=` or an alphanumeric follows (HTML attribute-value rule). `pass&#119ord` is a password input on the tokenizer path; the full classification path (classify → Enumerator → ProgressTable) records login_page/blocked/Blocked with zero items even when action="/list" and matching list links are present. `&#x70assword` is `&#x70a`+`ssword` for browsers and for this decoder — not a marker.

findings.title: Published PR metadata fails acceptance
findings.change: services/collect/evidence/PR_본문.md is rewritten for fix round 5 and pinned to input head c659ce8fedd22adde4e1796fa1e93456f6752f32 (the PR #144 head the review confirmed), with A/Q/L/I/M, R IDs, task ID, author role, execution path and no model identifier. This node cannot call GitHub; the supervisor's open_pr() writes the PR body once at first build and never rewrites it. Supervisor action after committing: `gh pr edit 144 --body-file services/collect/evidence/PR_본문.md`, fill in the final commit SHA, and omit the auto-generated `Builder:` line.

findings.title: HTTP access denial becomes failed in institution progress
findings.change: New Termination::AccessDenied { at_cursor, http_status } (serde kind `access_denied`) for 401/403 from the list URL; exploration_state_of maps it to ExplorationState::Blocked { reason: "access_denied" }, so scope_progress, the axis summary, DenominatorItem.unacquired (AcquisitionStatus::Blocked) and RoleCoverage.unacquired["blocked"] all stay blocked. Other HTTP errors remain FetchFailed → Failed.

findings.change: services/collect/src/adapters/verification-fix4.json and verification-fix5.json (both historical_only, superseded) moved to services/collect/evidence/historical/ via git mv so no temporary data remains in the product source tree.
